_about: Rows are front doors (the search starts there). Questions are asked as written: jurl --json --precise --follow 5 -q QUESTION FRONT. S1-S3 are the owner's developer sheets; R1-R6 are the real-world sheets (front doors checked to load with a browser user agent, 2026-10-10). R6es is R6 with the questions in Spanish.
